title: Flying a Kite
hook: 一家人去公园放风筝，风筝却挂到了树上，爸爸爬上去救风筝——结果全家都成了泥人。

cells.a: They were in the park on a bright, sunny day.
cells.cn: 晴天里，一家人在公园里。

cells.q: What did Peppa do to make the kite fly?
cells.a: She ran as fast as she could.
cells.cn: 她拼命地跑，想让风筝飞起来。

cells.a: Because it was windy, and the wind lifted the kite.
cells.cn: 因为起风了，风把风筝托起来。

cells.q: Who could fly the kite very well?
cells.a: Daddy Pig could. He flies the kite very well.
cells.cn: 猪爸爸很会放，放得特别好。

cells.a: Oh dear. It got caught in a tree.

cells.q: What do Peppa and George love?
cells.a: They love to jump in muddy puddles.

cells.q: Why could Daddy Pig not stand on the branch?
cells.a: Because he was much too heavy for it.
cells.cn: 因为他太重了，树枝撑不住。
每个人身上都溅满了泥。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say at the end?
cells.a: She said, “You can't get any muddier!”
cells.cn: 她说：“反正也没法更脏了！”

helper.order: First / Next / Then / After that / Finally
helper.keywords: kite, park, windy, tree, branch, mud
helper.actions: run, fly, catch, climb, jump, laugh

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “Flying a Kite”.
ending: In the end, the whole family is covered in mud. My favourite part is ______.
